messages:
Elaine: Quick prelaunch check — final pass on keywords, schema, internal links, redirects, and inbound routing for the webinar landing (Wed launch). Can people confirm their pieces? Looping in @chris_s and @maya. :eyes:

Chris S: Sharing the canonical/schema snippet I suggested in the doc: https://docs.google.com/xxx
Chris S: For canonical + JSON-LD, example:
```html
<link rel="canonical" href="https://redwood.com/webinar-launch" />
<script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Launch"}</script>
```
Chris S: Also 2 notes: 1) keep schema updated per variant (A/B), 2) prefer 301 for canonical redirects.

Maya: For internal anchors — we'll map 3 CTAs to funnel tags: hero -> top-funnel, mid -> demo, footer -> docs. I'll drop mapping by EOD.

Sam G: Question on inbound routing: webinar signups need to land in Marketo list 'Launch-Webinar-APR' with source=webinar-email. Can we confirm redirect params persist through Oauth/SAML flow? cc @eng-analytics

seo-bot: Audit summary: redirects ok except `/signup` -> `/register` returns 302 occasionally. Flags: 302 -> convert to 301, missing hreflang on /webinar variants.

Elaine: Action items:
- Chris: finalize schema + canonical by 11:00 PT tomorrow
- Maya: paste anchor -> tag mapping in the doc
- Sam: confirm routing/UTM persistence with eng-analytics
- Ops: sweep redirects for 301 vs 302

Maya: noted, will upload mapping: https://docs.google.com/yyy

Chris S: I'll update the PR with snippet and tests: `tests/test_schema.py::test_event_ld` :thumbsup:

Sam G: I'll sync with analytics and post update here within 6 hours.

Elaine: Thanks team — if no blockers we'll run the redirect batch Tuesday night. :rocket:
